text_block_list.text:
It's time for our meeting, but Mayano
Top Gun
still hasn't shown up...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! Did I keep you waiting,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: No, I just got here too.

text_block_list.text:
Nice! ☆ Is it just me, or does this feel
like a date?!
Eeek!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! I should say sorry first! I got
caught up
with some classmates...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Tomorrow's test day...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo depressed. Maybe I should just
skip...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Right?! Tests totally suck!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Even if you finish early, you can't take a
nap or
play with anyone! All you can do
is doodle!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh, Maya...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I'm so jealous. You're gonna breeze
through the
next test too, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Ehe, maybe!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I got it! Maya, tell us how to pass the
next test!
Teach us your ways!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Yeah! It'd be a huge help! Pleeease!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Copy that! ☆ Leave it to me! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So I helped them as much as I
could—which made
them really happy!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
They even asked me to help them again
next
time! Ehehe... It's tough being
popular! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган might be in good
spirits, but as
her trainer, I can't help but
worry that this may
end up being a
burden on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Are they going to give you anything as thanks?
Make sure to say no if you aren't in the mood.

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган might be in good
spirits, but as
her trainer, I can't help but
worry that this may
end up being a
burden on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Are they going to give you anything as thanks?
Make sure to say no if you aren't in the mood.

text_block_list.text:
Maybe if she were to get something out
of it, it'd
be a little easier on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! That totally slipped my mind!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A thank you gift, huh? ♪ What do you
think I
should ask for?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I got it! I'll make them promise to play
with me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Since it's test season, everyone's been so
busy
studying that we haven't played
together at all.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: I'm sure they have lots of time now.

text_block_list.text:
Definitely! I'll ask them to hang out
tomorrow! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: A thank you gift?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Yep! I want you to come play with me! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling kinda lonely lately
since
everyone's been so busy with
exams.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I've heard rumors of Maya's famous boot
camp...
You want us to play till we drop,
right?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Let's do it. I could use a break!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'd take on the boot camp any
day! ♪
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Let's play our hearts out!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Come on! You're such a worrier, you
know! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm more than happy to help, and I'm
glad that my
friends are learning!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Everything's great! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: How about you make me happy next?

text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay! Your wish is my
command! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
With a promise made, I set Mayano Top
Gun to
work in some intense training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Waaah! This doesn't make me happy at
all!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urgh... You're so mean, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Keep up the good work, Maya!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Your trainer's pretty skilled too,
knowing how to
handle you like that!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Totally! My trainer is super cool! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You know... you might want to pick an
attitude.
Pouty or happy, which is it?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
H-hey! The heart of a young maiden is

complicated, y'know!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Маяно Топ Ган
returns home
full of energy after having
hung out with her
friends right up until
curfew.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems Маяно Топ Ган has become a
bit wiser
after this experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
